column1: # A `coredump` partition was added (ota_1 shrunk 7M -> 6.75M) so flash coredumps work; `store`
# stays byte-identical at 0xe10000 (vintage config). In the launcher install the device table
# (partitions-launcher.csv) is what's flashed and vintage finds `coredump`/`store` by subtype/
# label at runtime — this build table just needs the partition present for the coredump build.
